name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – § 7/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘regrets the fact, however, that these security guarantees would only be implemented once a ceasefire is agreed upon;’
part_context: Welcomes the conclusions of the meeting of the ‘coalition of the willing’ held in Paris on 6 January 2026; strongly welcomes the proposal for a multinational ‘reassurance force’ for Ukraine; welcomes the agreement to finalise politically and legally binding commitments to restore peace and security in the event of a future, post-ceasefire, armed attack by Russia, alongside a clear framework for support to Ukraine, including the sustenance of its long-term military capabilities and deepened defence cooperation; <del>regrets the fact, however, that these security guarantees would only be implemented once a ceasefire is agreed upon;</del> takes note of the talks on a ceasefire monitoring and verification mechanism; underlines the need to implement these ambitious proposals;
